name: iperf3-docker
what_it_is: A minimal Docker image packaging the iperf3 network bandwidth testing tool, enabling containerised client/server throughput and latency measurements. It exposes the standard iperf3 CLI inside a lightweight container suitable for network performance benchmarking tasks.
components: minimal base OS image (Alpine or similar)
configuration: server mode: iperf3 -s (listens on port 5201 by default)
client mode: iperf3 -c <host> targeting a server endpoint
constraints: Repository returned HTTP 404 — README and docker-compose could not be fetched; fields derived from iperf3 public documentation and entry description only
No built-in orchestration — callers must manage network connectivity between client and server containers themselves
Single iperf3 process per container; no multi-session management layer
notable_absences: No web UI or REST API — CLI only
No persistent storage or result archiving built in
No TLS/authentication support in base iperf3
